visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a black and white patterned cardigan over a black blouse, stands against a red brick wall. She has her arms crossed and looks away with a sulking expression. (2) She turns her head to look directly at the camera with a serious, pouting face, then looks back down. The setting is outdoors near a historic-looking building with windows. (3) The scene transitions to a wide outdoor plaza where the woman is walking away. She spins around suddenly, showing a very angry face with fire graphics appearing behind her. (4) The woman stands in a busy city plaza. A hand reaches out from the side holding a stack of 1000 NTD bills. Upon seeing the money, she immediately changes to a wide smile and bright expression. (5) She excitedly gestures towards a large red truck branded with 'mercari' parked in a public square. People are seen in the background. (6) Inside the truck, she explores shelves filled with anime figures, plush toys, and handheld gaming consoles like a Nintendo DS. (7) She stands in front of a blue background inside the vehicle, holding a 'mercari' sign and pointing to a list of discount offers while smiling at the camera. (8) The woman is shown at a red station filled with colorful small balls, using a pink plastic scoop to dig out blue and red capsules. (9) Her hands are shown on an orange table turning over 'mercari' branded cards in a matching game. (10) Outdoors again, she stands next to a wooden lottery wheel, turning the handle as a colored ball drops out into a tray. (11) The video ends with a shot of the red promotional truck and text overlays showing event locations and dates.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, several background passers-by, and male hands appearing in frame.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with long, straight dark hair and bangs. She is wearing a black-and-white patterned oversized cardigan over a black shirt with a bow, and a white pleated long skirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Initial scenes are against a red brick wall (Ximen Red House). Later scenes move to an open urban square with modern buildings and a large red promotional vehicle ('Mercari' truck). Interior shots show blue shelves with merchandise.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo electronic pop music fades in. A female voice speaks with exaggerated annoyance, followed by a soft male apologetic voice. (2) A loud 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the shift in vocal tone as the female starts shouting in a mock-angry comedic style. (3) A 'cha-ching' cash sound effect triggers as money is mentioned, and the female voice instantly becomes high-pitched and joyful. (4) Fast-paced narration continues over driving drum beats. Multiple UI 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects punctuate the description of products and discounts. (5) Plastic rustling and thudding sounds occur as the host plays a ball-digging game, synchronized with 'sparkle' SFX. (6) A loud metallic 'ding' bell rings as a lottery wheel is spun, followed by a triumphant comic sound effect. (7) The video concludes with the female speaker rapidly delivering event dates and locations over the persistent energetic music bed.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Mercari' mobile marketplace app and its physical promotional event in Taipei, highlighting registration discounts and interactive games to attract new users.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the brand, showing the branded promotional truck, and explaining registration discounts and event locations.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A typical high-energy social media promotional video using a skit intro to hook viewers before transitioning into a detailed event and app feature showcase.
